description: This file implements the GstWrapper class and related factory functions for managing GStreamer objects, including methods for creating and setting GStreamer structures and caps, with logging and exception handling.

classes.name: GstWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class providing methods to interact with GStreamer structures and caps.
